about.title: Turning Ideas into Interactive Digital Products
description: I’m Mohammed El Aouri, a creative and self-driven Full-Stack Web Developer with a strong foundation in modern development tools like React.js, Node.js, Java Spring, and LaravelWith a background in both web and mobile development I blend clean code, performance-first thinking, and user-centered design to build reliable, scalable digital products

Over the past few years, I’ve completed 50+ real-world JavaScript projects, contributed to open source, and published technical content across platforms like Medium and Dev.to. I also maintain a growing open-source JavaScript course on GitHub, and I’m currently working on a complete Python course aimed at beginners. ...

I hold a Specialized Technician Diploma in Digital Development, with hands-on experience building applications using Java Spring/Angular and Laravel/React during internships and training. I’m now preparing to launch a YouTube channel to share tutorials, dev tips, and project breakdowns in a clear and engaging way.

I’m passionate about continuous learning, clean architecture, and contributing to teams that value creativity, collaboration, and growth.
I'm ready to bring value, energy, and innovation to your team.
